text:
Maya Chen: Heads up — OrionCloud just flagged a cancelled freight for our March reserved shipment. They say container #OC-7782 was rerouted and inventory is delayed 7-10 days. This impacts two SKU bundles: RWD-GPU-8 and RWD-SSD-1TB.
TJ Park: Ugh. How many units per SKU are affected?
Maya Chen: Roughly 120 of RWD-GPU-8 and 340 of RWD-SSD-1TB on the manifest. Manifest excerpt:```OC-7782 \nRWD-GPU-8 x120\nRWD-SSD-1TB x340\nETA: 2026-03-28 -> CANCELLED```
Sam Kline: Do we have any alternate partner stock or marketplace listings we can pull from to cover committed Dedicated customers?
Olivia Reyes: We have 50 GPUs in the APAC marketplace pool and 80 in NA but those are unreserved. We could push a temporary marketplace allocation and grant credits. @Ash Patel can we make credits available if we reassign capacity?
Ash Patel: We can do one-off credits for affected customers; need a list of customer IDs and commitments. Send me estimated delta and I’ll fast-track approval.
Maya Chen: Adding: impacted customers = [cust-773, cust-904, cust-1120]. Estimated shortfall per customer: cust-773 (-40 GPUs), cust-904 (-30 GPUs), cust-1120 (-50 GPUs).
TJ Park: Two things: 1) ask OrionCloud for earliest container reroute details and whether they can split shipment to partial fulfill earlier; 2) propose temporary model throttling + quota swaps so critical jobs still have throughput.
Maya Chen: Reached out to Orion rep (Anya). She replied: "Investigating options to split to air freight for priority SKUs; waiting on freight partner confirmation." She gave a provisional ETA window of 6-9 days if air moves.
Orion Bot: Partner notice: OrionCloud update received for OC-7782 — status CHANGED -> reroute_investigation. Tracking link: https://partners.orioncloud/track/OC-7782
Sam Kline: If air freight looks expensive, propose we refill critical customers from marketplace pool and apply a temporary surcharge waiver. Olivia, can you draft the customer-facing note? Keep it simple: ETA shift + remediation plan + credit.
Olivia Reyes: Will draft. Suggest wording: "Due to an unexpected logistics reroute with a partner carrier, your reserved capacity may be delayed by up to 10 days. We are reallocating temporary capacity and issuing account credits where applicable. We'll follow up with exact ETA within 48 hours." Thoughts?
TJ Park: Sounds good. Also need an internal ops plan: - mark affected Dedicated reservations as "at-risk" in the reservation dashboard - open a build queue throttle for non-critical workloads - enable GPU oversubscribe on affected clusters to reassign cycles
Maya Chen: I can flag reservations and open the Ops ticket. Sam, can you lead the marketplace reassign and confirm exact unit pulls?
Sam Kline: On it. I'll coordinate with marketplace ops and confirm which units we can legally reassign vs. sell-through.
Ash Patel: Once Sam confirms numbers, I'll approve credits. Also confirm whether customers require SLA credits or pro-rated refunds.
Olivia Reyes: Draft customer note done, will wait on ETA before sending.
Maya Chen: Quick ask — prioritize RWD-GPU-8 for air-split if partner can. That's our highest-impact SKU for Dedicated customers.
TJ Park: Agreed. If Orion can't split, we move 80 GPUs from NA marketplace pool and escalate procurement for emergency spot buy.
Maya Chen: TY. I'll update this thread when Orion confirms air freight decision. For now: action items assigned: Sam (marketplace reassign), Olivia (customer note), Ash (credits approval), TJ (ops throttles), Maya (partner follow-up + reservation flags).
Olivia Reyes: :thumbsup:
Sam Kline: Will post marketplace poll + numbers in 30m.
Orion Bot: Partner update (later): OrionCloud confirms partial split feasible — air freight holds for 60 units of RWD-GPU-8, ground will follow. New tentative ETA for air batch: 2026-03-26.
Maya Chen: Good news. Sam — adjust pulls: move 20 GPUs from NA pool + accept Orion air 60 to cover top customers. Remaining shortfall still ~40 GPUs; consider one-time spot buy.
Sam Kline: Done — updated numbers and moved 20 units. Marketplace status: NA pool now 60 -> 40 after reassignment.
Ash Patel: Approving credits for the three affected accounts. I'll post amounts after Sam finalizes numbers.
TJ Park: I'll start ops throttle plan and flag reservations as "partial fulfillment" in the console.
Maya Chen: Closing loop — thanks team. Will post final ETA when confirmed by carrier.
Olivia Reyes: Sending customer notes once Maya confirms new ETA.
Maya Chen: :white_check_mark:
